findings.title: Selective attenuation is not operational
findings.finding: The production offscreen callback always sends targetClassId=dishes to HybridDspSeparator; no detector or trigger decision gates it. HybridDspSeparator is explicitly a non-neural DFT mask, returns targetAttenuationDb=0 and speechPreservationDb=0, and production status calls it protecting.
findings.impact: This fails the mission's central overlapping speech+trigger gate and risks presenting heuristic mixed-signal modification as selective separation.

findings.title: Detector is orphaned from the release graph
findings.finding: LocalSoundDetector exists only under extension/src and is exercised by its unit test; the build entrypoints are src/background.ts, src/offscreen/offscreen.ts, and src/ui/main.tsx, and none imports or initializes the detector.
findings.impact: No real semantic detection, P0 trigger selection, or detector-originated SensoryEvent can occur in the shipped path.

findings.title: Production audio graph is mono ScriptProcessor plumbing, not the specified DSP pipeline
findings.finding: The runtime requests ScriptProcessor(1024,1,1), reads channel 0, writes channel 0, and bypasses directly to destination when processing is unavailable. RingBuffer, SmoothGain, and StableAudioProcessor live in extension/src/audio but are not imported by the production build.
findings.impact: Stereo compatibility, frame buffering, crossfade, limiter, and low-latency worklet behavior are unproven or absent.

findings.title: Sensory X-Ray has no live producer
findings.finding: The UI subscribes to SENSORY_EVENT and renders confidence, but the offscreen runtime emits only ENGINE_STATUS. The event type has no attenuation, engine, or protected/softened fields, and the UI explicitly renders attenuation as unavailable/not measured.
findings.impact: The required real detection/action timeline cannot be demonstrated.

findings.title: Intake cannot authorize the required model integration
findings.finding: Only open_unmix/SOURCE.json has license_status=VERIFIED. Semantic Hearing, AudioSep, YAMNet, ONNX Runtime, Chrome samples, RNNoise, and Demucs SOURCE.json files have null license_status; model weights are blocked without explicit artifact licensing.
findings.impact: No required detector or target separator can be integrated under the mission's verified-only rule from this intake as recorded.

findings.title: Benchmark and browser proof do not establish the product gate
findings.finding: bench/results/latest.json reports separatorAdapter.available=false and selective/detection/latency metrics NOT_RUN. The separate hybrid evidence is deterministic synthetic/offline evidence. All eight evidence/browser/latest.json checks are UNVERIFIED.
findings.impact: There is no release evidence for target attenuation, speech preservation, real-time latency, or actual Chrome behavior.

findings.title: Settings and controls are not connected
findings.finding: Settings migration/storage and trigger policy helpers exist, but UI rules/global strength are local React state and no runtime handler loads/saves audioshield.settings or handles TRIGGER_RULES_SET.
findings.impact: User-selected rules do not govern the audio runtime or persist across sessions/sites.

verification.build: NOT_RUN: build script deletes/recreates dist; Worker 0 is read-only except the evidence file
verification.browserSmoke: UNVERIFIED: all checks in evidence/browser/latest.json are UNVERIFIED

requiredNextOrchestratorAction: Do not claim RELEASE_READY. Assign disjoint implementation lanes only after resolving intake license/weight blockers; wire a real detector, policy, browser-capable target-conditioned separator, stereo-safe DSP graph, event bus, settings persistence, and measured Chrome/overlap evidence.
